trap.label: sujeito do particípio
trap.wrong: Working at an institute, statistics became easy for me.
trap.right: Working at an institute, I found statistics easy.
trap.why: Em português o gerúndio é mais livre quanto ao sujeito. Em inglês, o sujeito da oração principal deve ser quem faz a ação do particípio.

mcq.q: “___ in two packages, I can start now.”
Who is “working” in: “Working at an institute, I learned statistics”?
Which participle sentence has a clear subject?
opts: Seeing the error, the chart was corrected.
Seeing the error, she corrected the chart.

fix.wrong: Having finished the course, the job was easy.
fix.right: Having finished the course, he found the job easy.

fix.wrong: Train in Python, she applied for the job.
fix.right: Trained in Python, she applied for the job.

fix.wrong: Be a data analyst, I use two packages.
fix.right: Being a data analyst, I use two packages.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza com -ing: “Because I work at an institute, I learned statistics.”
rewrite.answer: Working at an institute, I learned statistics.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza com having + pp: “After I had finished the course, I applied.”
rewrite.answer: Having finished the course, I applied.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza com -ed: “Because I was trained in two packages, I can start.”
rewrite.answer: Trained in two packages, I can start.
